# NEW 2026-11-21 v8.5 Part B: Unified Empire Entropy Anti-Snowball Engine (oe_ent_, Slot 65). Generated by gen_empire_entropy.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# Country scope. Unified Empire Entropy Engine effects (Slot 65).
# Zero double-penalty guarantee for BYZ/ROM:
#   - When rule #9 is Lite: universal engine stays off and oe_ar_burden runs completely untouched.
#   - When rule #9 is Standard/Hardcore: once oe_ar_strain is active on BYZ/ROM, oe_ent_sync_ar_and_tiers
#     synchronizes var:oe_ar_strain = var:oe_ent_index and removes oe_ar_strained / oe_ar_overburdened so only
#     the unified 4-tier oe_ent_tier_* modifier applies.

# Country scope. Adjusts var:oe_ent_index by $amt$, clamps 0..100, and immediately syncs tier & oe_ar_strain.
oe_ent_add_index = {
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_ent_index } }
        set_variable = { name = oe_ent_index value = 0 }
    }
    change_variable = { name = oe_ent_index add = $amt$ }
    clamp_variable = { name = oe_ent_index min = 0 max = 100 }
    oe_ent_sync_ar_and_tiers = yes
}

# Country scope. Clears all 4 tier modifiers (used on Lite mode or when an empire shrinks below threshold).
oe_ent_remove_tier_mods = {
    remove_country_modifier = oe_ent_tier_steady
    remove_country_modifier = oe_ent_tier_pressure
    remove_country_modifier = oe_ent_tier_crisis
    remove_country_modifier = oe_ent_tier_decay
}

# Country scope. Lite mode cleanup: removes universal oe_ent_tier_* without touching oe_ar_strained/oe_ar_overburdened.
oe_ent_clear_lite_mode = {
    oe_ent_remove_tier_mods = yes
}

# Country scope. Synchronizes 4-tier modifiers (mode = replace) and merges cleanly with oe_ar_strain (no double penalty).
oe_ent_sync_ar_and_tiers = {
    if = {
        limit = { oe_ent_rule_active = yes has_variable = oe_ent_index }
        clamp_variable = { name = oe_ent_index min = 0 max = 100 }
        # Bidirectional merge with oe_ar_burden on BYZ/ROM: keep oe_ar_strain in lockstep and strip duplicate tier mods.
        if = {
            limit = { has_variable = oe_ar_strain }
            set_variable = { name = oe_ar_strain value = var:oe_ent_index }
            clamp_variable = { name = oe_ar_strain min = 0 max = 100 }
            remove_country_modifier = oe_ar_strained
            remove_country_modifier = oe_ar_overburdened
        }
        oe_ent_remove_tier_mods = yes
        if = {
            limit = { trigger_if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_ent_index } var:oe_ent_index >= 80 } }
            add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_ent_tier_decay years = -1 mode = replace }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { trigger_if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_ent_index } var:oe_ent_index >= 55 } }
            add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_ent_tier_crisis years = -1 mode = replace }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { trigger_if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_ent_index } var:oe_ent_index >= 30 } }
            add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_ent_tier_pressure years = -1 mode = replace }
        }
        else = {
            add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_ent_tier_steady years = -1 mode = replace }
        }
    }
}

# Country scope. Recomputes and caches the 5 transparent dimensions (O(1) variables), net monthly delta,
# and 4 scalar mitigation snapshots so GUI frames NEVER run any iterator.
oe_ent_recalc_cache = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_ent_d1_overext value = oe_ent_calc_d1 }
    set_variable = { name = oe_ent_d2_inflation value = oe_ent_calc_d2 }
    set_variable = { name = oe_ent_d3_satrapy value = oe_ent_calc_d3 }
    set_variable = { name = oe_ent_d4_culture value = oe_ent_calc_d4 }
    set_variable = { name = oe_ent_d5_war value = oe_ent_calc_d5 }
    set_variable = { name = oe_ent_raw_sum value = var:oe_ent_d1_overext }
    change_variable = { name = oe_ent_raw_sum add = var:oe_ent_d2_inflation }
    change_variable = { name = oe_ent_raw_sum add = var:oe_ent_d3_satrapy }
    change_variable = { name = oe_ent_raw_sum add = var:oe_ent_d4_culture }
    change_variable = { name = oe_ent_raw_sum add = var:oe_ent_d5_war }
    if = {
        limit = { trigger_if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_ent_raw_sum } var:oe_ent_raw_sum > 0 } }
        set_variable = { name = oe_ent_raw_pos value = 1 }
    }
    else = {
        set_variable = { name = oe_ent_raw_pos value = 0 }
    }
    set_variable = { name = oe_ent_delta value = oe_ent_calc_net_delta }
    if = {
        limit = { oe_ent_is_byz_or_rom = yes }
        set_variable = { name = oe_ent_cache_prf_rel value = oe_prf_strain_relief }
        set_variable = { name = oe_ent_cache_prf_civ value = oe_prf_civil_prefectures }
        set_variable = { name = oe_ent_cache_prf_mil value = oe_prf_mil_prefectures }
        set_variable = { name = oe_ent_cache_low_loy value = oe_ent_low_loyal_themes }
    }
    else = {
        set_variable = { name = oe_ent_cache_prf_rel value = 0 }
        set_variable = { name = oe_ent_cache_prf_civ value = 0 }
        set_variable = { name = oe_ent_cache_prf_mil value = 0 }
        set_variable = { name = oe_ent_cache_low_loy value = 0 }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { has_variable = oe_ar_strain oe_ent_rule_active = yes NOT = { has_variable = oe_ent_ar_merged } }
        set_variable = { name = oe_ent_ar_merged value = 1 }
    }
}

# Country scope. Shared countermeasure payloads (single source of truth for oe_ent_decisions.txt & oe_ent_ui.txt).
oe_ent_do_currency_reform = {
    add_gold = -220
    add_estate_satisfaction = { type = estate_type:burghers_estate value = estate_satisfaction_weak_penalty }
    add_inflation = inflation_mild_bonus
    set_variable = { name = oe_ent_cd_currency months = 120 }
    add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_ent_mod_currency_reform years = 10 mode = replace }
    oe_ent_add_index = { amt = -8 }
    oe_ent_recalc_cache = yes
}

oe_ent_do_admin_inspect = {
    add_gold = -200
    add_stability = -4
    add_estate_satisfaction = { type = estate_type:nobles_estate value = estate_satisfaction_mild_penalty }
    set_variable = { name = oe_ent_cd_inspect months = 120 }
    add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_ent_mod_admin_inspect years = 10 mode = replace }
    if = {
        limit = { oe_ent_is_byz_or_rom = yes }
        every_subject = {
            limit = { has_variable = oe_ar_exarchate }
            oe_ts_recent_loy = { amount = 10 }
        }
    }
    oe_ent_add_index = { amt = -10 }
    oe_ent_recalc_cache = yes
}

oe_ent_do_tolerance_charter = {
    add_gold = -160
    add_prestige = -10
    add_estate_satisfaction = { type = estate_type:clergy_estate value = estate_satisfaction_mild_penalty }
    set_variable = { name = oe_ent_cd_tolerance months = 120 }
    add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_ent_mod_tolerance_charter years = 10 mode = replace }
    oe_ent_add_index = { amt = -8 }
    oe_ent_recalc_cache = yes
}

oe_ent_do_amnesty_peace = {
    add_gold = -180
    add_prestige = -12
    add_war_exhaustion = war_exhaustion_severe_bonus
    set_variable = { name = oe_ent_war_months value = 0 }
    set_variable = { name = oe_ent_cd_amnesty months = 72 }
    add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_ent_mod_amnesty_peace years = 6 mode = replace }
    oe_ent_add_index = { amt = -12 }
    oe_ent_recalc_cache = yes
}

# Country scope. Core monthly tick for an eligible empire (called via oe_ent_monthly).
oe_ent_country_tick = {
    # 1. First-time initialization (if BYZ already has oe_ar_strain active, seed from it seamlessly!)
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_ent_index } }
        if = {
            limit = { has_variable = oe_ar_strain }
            set_variable = { name = oe_ent_index value = var:oe_ar_strain }
            set_variable = { name = oe_ent_ar_merged value = 1 }
        }
        else = {
            set_variable = { name = oe_ent_index value = 10 }
        }
        set_variable = { name = oe_ent_low_months value = 0 }
        set_variable = { name = oe_ent_war_months value = 0 }
        set_variable = { name = oe_ent_wait value = 0 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { has_variable = oe_ar_strain NOT = { has_variable = oe_ent_ar_merged } }
        # Newly transitioned into post-Restoration Rome: blend cleanly without double jump.
        set_variable = { name = oe_ent_ar_merged value = 1 }
        set_variable = { name = oe_ar_strain value = var:oe_ent_index }
    }

    # 2. Update prolonged-war counter (Dimension 5 transparency)
    if = {
        limit = { at_war = yes }
        if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_ent_war_months } } set_variable = { name = oe_ent_war_months value = 0 } }
        change_variable = { name = oe_ent_war_months add = 1 }
        clamp_variable = { name = oe_ent_war_months min = 0 max = 240 }
    }
    else = {
        set_variable = { name = oe_ent_war_months value = 0 }
    }

    # 3. Recompute 5 transparent dimensions & apply net monthly delta
    oe_ent_recalc_cache = yes
    change_variable = { name = oe_ent_index add = var:oe_ent_delta }
    clamp_variable = { name = oe_ent_index min = 0 max = 100 }

    # 4. Sync unified 4-tier modifiers & oe_ar_strain (0 double penalty)
    oe_ent_sync_ar_and_tiers = yes

    # 5. Track consecutive low-entropy months (< 30) toward Pax Imperialis (120 months)
    if = {
        limit = { trigger_if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_ent_index } var:oe_ent_index < 30 } }
        if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_ent_low_months } } set_variable = { name = oe_ent_low_months value = 0 } }
        change_variable = { name = oe_ent_low_months add = 1 }
        clamp_variable = { name = oe_ent_low_months min = 0 max = 120 }
    }
    else = {
        set_variable = { name = oe_ent_low_months value = 0 }
    }

    # 6. Event dispatch (respects BYZ mainline lock with 4-month force cap; per-country 12-month spacing)
    if = {
        limit = { oe_ent_pax_ready = yes }
        set_variable = { name = oe_ent_pax_done value = 1 }
        set_variable = { name = oe_ent_ev_m value = oe_ent_m_now }
        if = { limit = { tag = BYZ } oe_ml_take_as = { line = 65 } }
        trigger_event_non_silently = oe_ent.6
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = {
            oe_ent_event_pace_ok = yes
            OR = {
                NOT = { tag = BYZ }
                oe_ml_free = yes
                AND = {
                    has_variable = oe_ent_wait
                    trigger_if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_ent_wait } var:oe_ent_wait >= 4 }
                }
            }
        }
        # .1 First warning once entropy >= 30
        if = {
            limit = { oe_ent_idx_ge_30 = yes NOT = { has_variable = oe_ent_done_1 } }
            set_variable = { name = oe_ent_done_1 value = 1 }
            set_variable = { name = oe_ent_wait value = 0 }
            set_variable = { name = oe_ent_ev_m value = oe_ent_m_now }
            if = { limit = { tag = BYZ } oe_ml_take_as = { line = 65 } }
            trigger_event_non_silently = oe_ent.1
        }
        # .7 Great Yuan governance flavor (once for CHI, post-1400 restored Yuan only)
        else_if = {
            limit = { oe_ent_yuan_flavor_ok = yes oe_ent_idx_ge_25 = yes NOT = { has_variable = oe_ent_done_7 } }
            set_variable = { name = oe_ent_done_7 value = 1 }
            set_variable = { name = oe_ent_ev_m value = oe_ent_m_now }
            trigger_event_non_silently = oe_ent.7
        }
        # .8 Tsarist Russia governance flavor (once for RUS)
        else_if = {
            limit = { tag = RUS oe_ent_idx_ge_25 = yes NOT = { has_variable = oe_ent_done_8 } }
            set_variable = { name = oe_ent_done_8 value = 1 }
            set_variable = { name = oe_ent_ev_m value = oe_ent_m_now }
            trigger_event_non_silently = oe_ent.8
        }
        # .5 Tier IV Great Reckoning (>= 75, 20-year cooldown)
        else_if = {
            limit = { oe_ent_idx_ge_75 = yes NOT = { has_variable = oe_ent_cd_e5 } }
            random = {
                chance = 18
                set_variable = { name = oe_ent_cd_e5 years = 20 }
                set_variable = { name = oe_ent_wait value = 0 }
                set_variable = { name = oe_ent_ev_m value = oe_ent_m_now }
                if = { limit = { tag = BYZ } oe_ml_take_as = { line = 65 } }
                trigger_event_non_silently = oe_ent.5
            }
        }
        # .2 Silver Price Revolution shock
        else_if = {
            limit = { oe_ent_silver_crisis_ok = yes }
            random = {
                chance = 10
                set_variable = { name = oe_ent_cd_e2 years = 15 }
                set_variable = { name = oe_ent_wait value = 0 }
                set_variable = { name = oe_ent_ev_m value = oe_ent_m_now }
                if = { limit = { tag = BYZ } oe_ml_take_as = { line = 65 } }
                trigger_event_non_silently = oe_ent.2
            }
        }
        # .3 Frontier governor tax-withholding crisis
        else_if = {
            limit = { oe_ent_satrap_crisis_ok = yes }
            random = {
                chance = 10
                set_variable = { name = oe_ent_cd_e3 years = 12 }
                set_variable = { name = oe_ent_wait value = 0 }
                set_variable = { name = oe_ent_ev_m value = oe_ent_m_now }
                if = { limit = { tag = BYZ } oe_ml_take_as = { line = 65 } }
                trigger_event_non_silently = oe_ent.3
            }
        }
        # .4 Restive multi-ethnic frontier provinces
        else_if = {
            limit = { oe_ent_culture_crisis_ok = yes }
            random = {
                chance = 10
                set_variable = { name = oe_ent_cd_e4 years = 12 }
                set_variable = { name = oe_ent_wait value = 0 }
                set_variable = { name = oe_ent_ev_m value = oe_ent_m_now }
                if = { limit = { tag = BYZ } oe_ml_take_as = { line = 65 } }
                trigger_event_non_silently = oe_ent.4
            }
        }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { tag = BYZ oe_ent_idx_ge_30 = yes NOT = { has_variable = oe_ent_done_1 } }
        change_variable = { name = oe_ent_wait add = 1 }
    }
}

# Scheduler Slot 65 entry point (deduplicated per country & calendar month via var:oe_ent_ran_m).
# Safe to call from both gen_mainline_lock.py (BYZ scope, after Slot 43 prf) and oe_ent_pulse.txt (all giant empires).
oe_ent_monthly = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            is_rebel_country = no
            NOT = { var:oe_ent_ran_m ?= oe_ent_m_now }
        }
        set_variable = { name = oe_ent_ran_m value = oe_ent_m_now }
        if = {
            limit = { oe_rule_is_empire_entropy_lite = yes }
            if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_ent_index } oe_ent_clear_lite_mode = yes }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { oe_ent_eligible_empire = yes }
            oe_ent_country_tick = yes
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { has_variable = oe_ent_index num_locations < 120 }
            oe_ent_remove_tier_mods = yes
        }
    }
}

# ---- TEST ONLY helpers (called by DEV_LINES ent* on Page 65)
oe_ent_test_start = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_ent_force_on value = 1 }
    remove_variable = oe_ent_ran_m
    oe_ent_monthly = yes
    trigger_event_non_silently = oe_ent.90
}

oe_ent_test_tick = {
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_ent_index } } set_variable = { name = oe_ent_force_on value = 1 } }
    remove_variable = oe_ent_ran_m
    oe_ent_monthly = yes
}

oe_ent_test_high = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_ent_force_on value = 1 }
    set_variable = { name = oe_ent_index value = 82 }
    oe_ent_recalc_cache = yes
    oe_ent_sync_ar_and_tiers = yes
    trigger_event_non_silently = oe_ent.90
}

oe_ent_test_pax = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_ent_force_on value = 1 }
    remove_variable = oe_ent_pax_done
    set_variable = { name = oe_ent_index value = 12 }
    set_variable = { name = oe_ent_low_months value = 119 }
    remove_variable = oe_ent_ran_m
    oe_ent_monthly = yes
}

    remove_country_modifier = oe_ent_mod_rus_guberniya_audit
